name: Hishikawa Karen
source:
[url=/c101329]Riku[/url]'s younger sister, calls him "Onii-chan". 

She just came back from Thailand after 3 years and don't know how to interact with her brother, resulting with rude attitude toward him. She goes to the same all-girl school as [url=/c17502]Shiina[/url].
